mapper.select: SELECT pu.[DateTime] AS purchaseDate, pd.UnitPrice AS unitPrice, pd.Quantity AS quantity, pu.[No] AS purchaseNo, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(purchaseSupplier.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(purchaseSupplier.NameP)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(defaultSupplier.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(defaultSupplier.NameP)), '') ) AS supplierName FROM dbo.PurchaseDetails pd INNER JOIN dbo.Purchases pu ON pu.GUID = pd.MasterGUID LEFT JOIN dbo.Suppliers purchaseSupplier ON purchaseSupplier.GUID = pu.SupplierGUID OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 prod.DefaultSupplierGUID FROM dbo.Products prod WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(prod.Barcode, ''))) = #{barcode} ORDER BY prod.UpdateTime DESC, prod.GUID DESC ) productRow LEFT JOIN dbo.Suppliers defaultSupplier ON defaultSupplier.GUID = productRow.DefaultSupplierGUID WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, ''))) = #{barcode} AND pd.UnitPrice IS NOT NULL AND pd.UnitPrice > 0 ORDER BY pu.[DateTime] ASC, pd.[No] ASC
mapper.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, ''))) AS barcode, pd.[Name] AS purchaseNameChinese, pd.NameP AS purchaseNameForeign, pd.UnitPrice AS unitPrice, pu.[DateTime] AS purchaseDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, ''))) ORDER BY pu.[DateTime] DESC, pd.[No] DESC ) AS rn_latest, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, ''))) ORDER BY pu.[DateTime] ASC, pd.[No] ASC ) AS rn_first, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, '')))) AS purchase_count FROM dbo.PurchaseDetails pd INNER JOIN dbo.Purchases pu ON pu.GUID = pd.MasterGUID WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pd.Barcode, ''))) <> '' AND pd.UnitPrice IS NOT NULL AND pd.UnitPrice > 0 ), latest AS ( SELECT barcode, purchaseNameChinese, purchaseNameForeign, unitPrice AS latestPrice, purchaseDate AS latestPurchaseDate FROM ranked WHERE rn_latest = 1 ), previous AS ( SELECT barcode, unitPrice AS previousPrice FROM ranked WHERE rn_latest = 2 )

SELECT l.barcode, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(productRow.nameChinese)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(l.purchaseNameChinese)), '') ) AS nameChinese, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(productRow.nameForeign)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(l.purchaseNameForeign)), '') ) AS nameForeign, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.NameP)), '') ) AS supplierName, ROUND(p.previousPrice, 2) AS previousPrice, ROUND(l.latestPrice, 2) AS latestPrice, ROUND(ROUND(l.latestPrice, 2) - ROUND(p.previousPrice, 2), 2) AS changeAmount, l.latestPurchaseDate
ORDER BY changeAmount DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT l.barcode, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(productRow.nameChinese)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(l.purchaseNameChinese)), '') ) AS nameChinese, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(productRow.nameForeign)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(l.purchaseNameForeign)), '') ) AS nameForeign, COALESCE( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.NameP)), '') ) AS supplierName, ROUND(p.previousPrice, 2) AS previousPrice, ROUND(l.latestPrice, 2) AS latestPrice, ROUND(ROUND(l.latestPrice, 2) - ROUND(p.previousPrice, 2), 2) AS changeAmount, l.latestPurchaseDate
ORDER BY changeAmount DESC
